historical_reviews.deepseek: Does not test the source action and incorrectly reports no risk.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly restores the critical write and distinguishes version readback from flash completion.
historical_reviews.history: Sequence 543 is the distinct UEFI-version UI variant and supplies no powered-on-flash conclusion.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Powered-on support must be explicit for the exact utility and platform; a running OS and readable SMBIOS do not prove write safety.

original_test_intent: Use a vendor-supported in-service/powered-on path to flash the identified board's BIOS, then reboot and prove the target version plus normal host/BMC health.
original_method: Bind target/image and powered-on vendor utility, drain workloads and preserve state, validate stable power/recovery, approve one exact write/reboot, monitor full completion without interruption, then verify BIOS Setup, OS/BMC version and post-boot health.
manual_activity: Owner approves powered-on support, target/image/command, workload interruption and recovery; operator supervises the critical write/reboot and BIOS Setup. Duplicate UEFI-version UI case remains separate.
required_inputs: Tested recovery and explicit write/reboot approval
safety_requirements: Do not expose credentials or bypass host identity
Verify workload, target and image immediately before write
Stop on unsupported status or telemetry loss
No auto-retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Collect BIOS Setup and OS/BMC health evidence
engineer_actions: Provide stable power and independent recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `dmidecode -t 0` can provide one post-check, but unsafe SSH plus a version grep neither performs nor proves the required flash and must not be applied to the duplicate UI row.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After exact vendor support, image, utility, workload and recovery approval, run one monitored powered-on flash without interruption, perform the required reboot and correlate task telemetry with BIOS Setup and OS/BMC evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Powered-on flash, reboot, BIOS/OS checks and 20/20-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Prove vendor support, isolate workload, retain complete write telemetry and compare multi-surface version/configuration/health after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact execution and recovery contract rather than substituting a version read.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Restores the entire state-changing source method and its service impact.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unsupported online flashing or lost power can brick the board and interrupt active users.

project_override_considerations: Project must name the exact supported powered-on path; the private version script is post-check only, and row-366 UEFI 2.8 observation is a separate variant.
expected_evidence: Stable power and complete flash telemetry

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Primary fields consistently request a powered-on flash; the readback script and DeepSeek version-only command are incomplete rather than contradictory. Duplicate row 366 is isolated.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The purpose is identifiable; supported utility, image, workload approval and recovery are finite prerequisites. Execution stops if the powered-on path cannot be proven.

review_improvement: Restores the omitted firmware write and critical service/recovery gates while retaining dmidecode only as supporting evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source acceptance depends on a successful powered-on write and reboot, not merely reading the existing version. Because that write can be conditionally executed only with vendor artifacts and explicit approval, DeepSeek YES changes to REQUIRES.
